sar.narrative: On 2016-12-29, customer account C08106 on card C08106-K1 incurred unauthorized activity totaling $128.33. Transaction 3583227 was executed via online channel under product category 'C' in billing region nan. Graph traversal identified that the activity originated from an unverified source inconsistent with the cardholder's historical baseline. When contacted for validation, the customer explicitly denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed physical retention of the card. The pattern represents unauthorized card-not-present exploitation. The compromised card was blocked, reissue initiated, and funds protected under Policy Rule R2.

stop_reason: Cardholder report and investigation confirmed unauthorized transaction (Rule R2).
